notablePrerequisites:
Kediss does not have summoning sickness.
Kediss is one of your commanders.
You have the highest life total among all players.
An opponent is unable to block Kediss.
description:
Declare Kediss as an attacker, choosing to attack an opponent unable to block.
Before damage, cast Hatred targeting Kediss and pay life equal to the highest life toal among your opponent.
Kediss kills the defending player.
Kediss triggers, dealing lethal damage to each other opponent.
